line: A master carver forgot the reward, then the fame, then even his body.
The scientist who named 'flow' said: the doing itself is the reward.
Goggles full of water, Phelps counted his strokes and set a world record.
In sport studies, 'how to do it' goals went with the biggest gains.
Old cook: 'Others are not me. What other time should I wait for?'
A postman built a palace alone: 10,000 days, 93,000 hours, 33 years.
Aim at the sky, and you shoot higher than aiming at a tree.
Aim as straight as you can. Hitting the mark: welcome, not the goal.
credit: Cicero, De Finibus III.22 · tr. Rackham

line: Om is the bow, the self the arrow. Aim with a careful mind.
Through yoga, a steady will holds the mind, the breath and the senses.
